script_text: Hold everything, Taurus, because the cosmos just shifted and you need to hear this right now. Venus, your ruling planet of love and abundance, is gliding into a powerful sextile with expansive Jupiter in your 9th House of Higher Learning, opening a door you didn't even know existed. In love, this harmonious aspect softens your stubborn Earth energy, making you magnetic today, so whether you're single or committed, say yes to that unexpected invitation, it could spark something extraordinary. For career, Mercury is energizing your 2nd House of Finances, so review your contracts and investments carefully because a small detail holds unexpected profit. Avoid rushing into any big financial commitment before sunset because Saturn's square is creating blind spots. Lean into your patient nature and you'll uncover a golden opportunity. Follow for tomorrow's reading, because what's building this week will shake your world.
